svg.title: Dithering on fine pixels and on coarse tiles
svg.desc: Top row: a photograph of a snake as the original, and the same photograph with 512 uniformly spaced colors, dithered and not dithered, one color per pixel. Bottom row: the photograph with one color per tile, as the 24-bit mean of each tile, and with the same colors dithered between tiles and not dithered. Dithering helps on the fine grid and hurts on the tiles.
svg.text: One color per pixel, 512 uniform colors
One color per 9 × 9 tile, the same 512 colors
